test_cases.title: Clock Range Sufficient for 2 Weeks
steps: Run system for 2 * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 seconds
expected: Clock values remain within valid range; no overflow detected

test_cases.title: Clock Range Boundary - 2 Weeks
steps: Run system for exactly 2 * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 seconds
expected: Clock values are valid and have not overflowed

test_cases.title: Clock Range Boundary - 2 Weeks + 1 Second
steps: Run system for 2 * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 + 1 seconds
expected: Clock values have overflowed, triggering an error condition

test_cases.title: Algorithm Stability - 2 Weeks
steps: Run algorithms continuously for 2 * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 seconds with typical input data
expected: Algorithm outputs remain stable and within expected bounds; no divergence or NaN values

test_cases.title: Algorithm Stability - Boundary - 2 Weeks
steps: Run algorithms continuously for exactly 2 * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 seconds with typical input data
expected: Algorithm outputs remain stable and within expected bounds

test_cases.title: Algorithm Execution Time - Faster than Real Time
steps: Measure execution time of algorithms for a given input
expected: Execution time is consistently less than the real time taken to process the same input

test_cases.title: Battery Life - 1 Hour
steps: Run device on battery power for 1 * 60 * 60 seconds in typical operational mode
expected: Device continues to operate without power failure for at least 1 hour

test_cases.title: Battery Life - Boundary - 1 Hour
steps: Run device on battery power for exactly 1 * 60 * 60 seconds in typical operational mode
expected: Device continues to operate without power failure for the full hour

test_cases.title: Battery Life - Boundary - 1 Hour + 1 Second
steps: Run device on battery power for 1 * 60 * 60 + 1 seconds in typical operational mode
expected: Device shuts down due to battery depletion

test_cases.title: Inspiration Detection - Positive
steps: Simulate patient inspiration
expected: Controller registers patient as inspired

test_cases.title: Inspiration Detection - Negative
steps: Verify no inspiration signal is present
expected: Controller does not register patient as inspired
